title: Where ProteinMPNN lives
story: ProteinMPNN isn't a command or a module. It's a GitHub repository copied into /opt/ProteinMPNN, and you run its Python script. Look inside that folder and type the full path of the script whose name ends in run.py in the answer box.

tasks.text: Type the full path of the main script

hints: The main script is protein_mpnn_run.py. Its full path starts with /opt/ProteinMPNN/.
